title: Click-through rate by industry: dated benchmarks

facts.fact: WordStream and LocaliQ's 2026 benchmark puts the median click-through rate for US search ads on Google and Microsoft at 6.64%, measured April 2025 to March 2026.
facts.quote: WordStream and LocaliQ’s 2026 benchmark puts the median click-through rate for US search ads on Google and Microsoft at 6.64%, measured April 2025 to March 2026.

facts.fact: The WordStream and LocaliQ 2026 edition of the search benchmark report was published May 18, 2026.
Median CTR for US search ads in the Arts & Entertainment industry is 12.75%, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Median cost per click for US search ads in the Arts & Entertainment industry is $1.63, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Median CTR for US search ads in the Animals & Pets industry is 7.49%, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Median cost per click for US search ads in the Animals & Pets industry is $4.06, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Median CTR for US search ads in the Apparel / Fashion & Jewelry industry is 6.64%, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Median cost per click for US search ads in the Apparel / Fashion & Jewelry industry is $4.44, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Median CTR for US search ads in the Attorneys & Legal Services industry is 5.87%, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Median cost per click for US search ads in the Attorneys & Legal Services industry is $9.87, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Median cost per click across all industries for US search ads is $5.42, per the 2026 WordStream edition as summarized by Digital Applied.
Focus Digital's 2026 study gives an average Facebook ad CTR of 0.90% across all campaign objectives.
facts.quote: Focus Digital’s 2026 study averages 0.90% on Facebook and 0.68% on Instagram, and its display study averages 0.46%.

facts.fact: Focus Digital's 2026 study gives an average Instagram ad CTR of 0.68% across all campaign objectives.
facts.quote: Focus Digital’s 2026 study averages 0.90% on Facebook and 0.68% on Instagram

facts.fact: Focus Digital's 2026 social study gives an average X ad CTR of 0.86% across all campaign objectives.
Focus Digital's 2026 social study gives an average TikTok ad CTR of 0.61% across all campaign objectives.
Focus Digital's 2026 social study gives an average LinkedIn ad CTR of 0.52% across all campaign objectives.
In Focus Digital's social study, Facebook traffic campaigns average a 1.93% CTR and Facebook lead campaigns average 2.70%.
facts.quote: Facebook traffic campaigns average 1.93% and lead campaigns 2.70%.

facts.fact: Focus Digital's display study, covering February to December 2025, puts the average display ad CTR at 0.46%.
facts.quote: covering February to December 2025, puts the average CTR at 0.46%

facts.fact: In Focus Digital's display study, real estate has the highest display CTR at 1.08%, and B2B services the lowest at 0.22%.
facts.quote: Real estate had the highest rate at 1.08%, which the study attributes to people actively researching property. B2B services had the lowest at 0.22%.

facts.fact: The 0.46% display CTR figure also appears in WordStream data from August 2017 to January 2018, a third-party source, according to Digital Applied.
facts.quote: The same number appears in [WordStream data from August 2017 to January 2018](https://www.digitalapplied.com/blog/display-advertising-benchmarks-2026-data-points)

facts.fact: Adwave's advertising service starts at $30 per day from one daily budget across TV, search, social and web.
On Adwave, TikTok ads start from $91 per day and must be turned on, depending on budget.
facts.quote: TikTok, for example, starts from $91 per day and must be turned on.

facts.fact: Click-through rate is calculated as clicks divided by impressions, times 100.
facts.quote: Click-through rate (CTR) is the share of ad impressions that end in a click: clicks divided by impressions, times 100.
